title: Thunder Blade
description:
Thunder Blade adds powerful elemental swords to Minecraft 1.20.1.
Fight with unique weapons.
body:
# ⚡ Thunder Blade

Thunder Blade is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds powerful elemental swords with unique designs and crafting recipes. Explore new combat styles using weapons inspired by fire, ice, thunder, wind, shadows, water, and more.

Whether you're fighting mobs, exploring caves, or upgrading your survival adventure, Thunder Blade introduces stronger and more exciting weapons to your world.

### 🔥 Features
10 Custom Swords
Custom Crafting Recipes
Custom Textures & Models
Elemental-Themed Weapons
Fabric Loader Support
Survival Friendly Gameplay
Minecraft 1.20.1 Support
⚔️ Swords Included
🔥 Lava Sword

A blazing weapon forged with the power of molten lava. Perfect for players who love fire-themed combat.

![lava sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8283d47aaf8e27388745b1be1ca9c723b57ee10f_0.webp)

⚡ Thunder Sword

A powerful sword inspired by lightning and storms. Designed for fast and aggressive battles.

![Thunder sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7698b21d96493b0a7a96239c1d3b69fd2f9eb621_0.webp)

❄️ Ice Sword

A frozen blade crafted from icy power. Cool design with a sharp appearance.

![Ice Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/931013ea106ee094770580b798774ea9881655eb_0.webp)

🌪️ Wind Sword

A lightweight sword inspired by the force of the wind.

![Wind Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29651f4cacba39acbe79e87a347f8af815b72f57_0.webp)

🌑 Shadow Sword

A dark and mysterious weapon created from shadow energy.

![Shadow Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/404dd0fd5ad8e5a332bdc36214c0557b8aeb969d_0.webp)

💎 Emerald Sword

A strong emerald-based sword with a clean and powerful design.

![Emerald Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/681f9d33a999a06c9904a5be26fb9add897dab90.png)

🌊 Water Sword

A sword inspired by flowing water and ocean energy.

![Water Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e18e06bcfccee7344250dc9fbf57b668ea231d5b_0.webp)

🌱 Dirt Sword

A simple but fun sword crafted from dirt materials.

![Dirt Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cb89b771fbd440281dd5727853f273bd4035d9e.png)

🪵 Log Sword

A wooden-themed sword made using logs.

![Log Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9c38fad1f632284557dc24570462b7e48eb1692_0.webp)

⭐ Super Sword

The ultimate weapon of the mod with a powerful appearance and high durability.

![Super Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0df36383aaea86934fa15568290f42afc5f346fa_0.webp)

🛠️ Requirements
Minecraft 1.20.1
Fabric Loader
📦 Installation
Install Fabric Loader
Install Fabric API
Place the mod file inside the mods folder
Launch Minecraft
❤️ Support

If you enjoy the mod, consider following the project and sharing feedback for future updates. More swords, abilities, animations, and effects are planned for upcoming versions.
